summary: Tested the redesigned password-reset email (the only email the app sends): template guardrails, delivery, the full reset flow end-to-end, protection against account enumeration, and the frontend forgot/reset UI. 7/7 pytest cases passed and all frontend flows passed. Backend log shows integrations.emergentagent.com returned 202 Accepted for delivered@resend.dev and for a fake @puntrank.com.au user, with no 4xx/5xx. I rendered the HTML on desktop and mobile: branded dark header, green pill button, grey footer. It looks professional.

minor.issue: send_email is awaited inside the request (httpx timeout 30s), so a registered email responds slower than an unknown one. Accounts can be enumerated by timing. Fix: send via FastAPI BackgroundTasks / asyncio.create_task.

issues: No <head> with <meta charset=utf-8> and <meta name=viewport>. Non-ASCII characters (em dash, middot) depend on the provider's MIME charset header.
No plain-text fallback URL under the button ('Or paste this link: ...'). Some clients and corporate filters strip button styling or links.
White text on #10B981 button is about 2.5:1 contrast, below WCAG AA. Use #059669 or darker.
Footer text #9ca3af on #f9fafb is about 2.5:1, low contrast. Use #6b7280.
No hidden preheader text, so the inbox preview shows 'PUNTRANK AUS Reset your password...'.

action_items: Optional: move the reset email send to a background task to remove the timing difference that allows enumeration
Optional email polish: add head/meta charset+viewport, a plain-text fallback link, a preheader, and darker button and footer colours for contrast
critical_code_review_comments: Template escapes first_name and EMAIL_FROM_NAME. The link uses the origin from _validate_origin (allowlist). Guardrails pass: no forms, https only, and the anchor text has no host.
The footer line 'We never ask for your password or card details by email' does not trip any _CRED_ASK phrase (verified).
Generic exception swallow + logger.warning in forgot_password correctly prevents a 5xx when delivery fails.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md. delivered@resend.dev password unchanged (newpass456); reset flow tested on throwaway users.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users test_reset_*@puntrank.com.au and test_ui_reset@puntrank.com.au were created and deleted. 16 older test_* users from prior iterations remain in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pages are behind an age gate: set localStorage pr_age18=1 first. Routes: /auth, /reset-password?token=. After a successful reset the app goes to /auth with a toast. Writing files under /app/backend/tests triggers a backend hot reload. Only 3 forgot-password emails were sent this run.
